name: Co., Muggy Collection
source:
Three magical sweets sisters Chocolat, Chuchu and Marcie (Mallow) have inherited their parents' cafe. One day at a fundraiser, Chocolat meets a cat who can speak human words.
"I can help you meownage your cafe," offers the cat.
And so the events begin!

This is a Cafe Management simulation game about anthropomorphized sweets as magical girls.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ071265.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
三个神奇糖果姐妹Chocolat、Chuchu和Marcie（Mallow）继承了父母的咖啡馆。有一天，在一次筹款活动中，巧克力遇到了一只会说人类语言的猫。
“我可以帮你经营你的咖啡馆，”猫说道。
活动就这样开始了！

这是一款将糖果拟人化为魔法少女的咖啡馆经营模拟游戏。

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ071265.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
